items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: I knew them at the time, because I always was hanging around the bandstand.

ctx.x: But anyway, another band that they only used when they had to was Louis Armstrong's band. He played, you know, he wasn't the leader. But he blew so damn loud that you had to have a hall as big as the auditorium to take him. And I'm not so sure he was always on the button with his notes either. He only became good, really good, when he began playing on the Steamer. He was the president. No, what is it? The Sidney or Capitola. Yeah, yeah, yeah. The bands that we danced by, the Silverleaf, Mapleleaf, Goldleaf,…
And you mentioned the other day you'd like to tell us something about that.
